* Build Systems That Act: Lead the development of Agentic AI state machines that can break down complex goals, evaluate progress, and self-correct (Reason-and-Act / ReAct loops).

--------------

Qualifications

--------------

* Engineering Foundation: 10-20 years of experience in software engineering, distributed systems, and data architecture, with at least 1-5 years in a technical leadership or management role.

* AI/ML Expertise: Proven hands-on experience building production-grade Generative AI applications, RAG pipelines, and working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models).

* Agentic Frameworks: Deep understanding of Agentic AI paradigms, state machines, and frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or proprietary orchestration systems.


*Experience with Ragas, Deep Eval, Langsmith

* Data Engineering Mastery: Strong background in ETL/ELT pipelines, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus), graph databases, and managing unstructured data at scale.

* Cloud & Infrastructure: Proficiency with cloud-native architectures (AWS/GCP), Kubernetes, and modern backend languages (Python, Go, or Java).

* Vision & Execution: Ability to balance cutting-edge AI research with pragmatic, highly reliable software engineering delivery.

Why Join Us? You will be at the forefront of transforming traditional business planning into an autonomous "Plan-Analyze-Act" cycle, working with top talent in the industry to build AI systems that are as reliable and secure as they are intelligent.

Job Description

Engineering Manager, AI/ML Innovation & Product Engineering

Job Title


Engineering Manager, AI/ML Innovation & Product Engineering

Function


BPS Innovation Lab Technology Build Team

Reporting To


Innovation & Growth Lab Head

Location


India Pune

Team Size


Leads the Labs tech team (AI/ML + full-stack, headcount grows with hiring)

Grade / Level


Manager

Employment Type


Full-Time


ROLE PURPOSE

The Engineering Manager, AI/ML Innovation & Product Engineering is the most critical technical hire in the Innovation Lab. This individual will design the architecture, build the initial versions, and establish the engineering standards for all AI-enabled and full-stack products developed by the Lab. Working closely with the Lab Head on commercial direction and leading the Labs tech team on execution, this role is the bridge between a validated business concept and a client-deployable product.

This role is ideal for a leader who is passionate about designing cutting-edge AI solutions, driving innovation, and delivering measurable business impact for global clients. The candidate should bring a builder’s mindset, hands-on expertise in AI/ML systems and Agentic AI, and the ability to translate complex client problems into scalable AI-powered solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Architecture & Technical Design

  • Design the end-to-end technical architecture for all AI/ML and full-stack products built by the Lab, including agentic workflows, API integrations, service architecture, and inference infrastructure
  • Lead solutioning discussions with global stakeholders to define AI-driven transformation roadmaps
  • Define and enforce engineering standards, code review protocols, and documentation practices across the full tech team (AI/ML and full-stack)
  • Evaluate and select the appropriate AI frameworks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party APIs (including LLM providers) for each product
  • Ensure architecture decisions account for client data residency, security requirements, and third-party processing constraints from Day 1
  • Own the IP integrity of all technical work — ensuring all code, models, and build artefacts are developed under ownership framework

2. AI Data Engineering & Pipelines

  • Own data pipelines for multi-modal and unstructured inputs — receipts, PDFs, vendor statements, contracts, email — across all Lab products
  • Build OCR/layout-parsing ingestion and structured-extraction pipelines from unstructured sources
  • Design and maintain embedding/vector-store architecture for RAG products; own retrieval quality
  • Set data quality, labeling, and validation standards for evaluation and fine-tuning datasets
  • Build reusable schema-on-read patterns for semi-structured ERP exports (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite)

3. MLOps, Evaluation & Observability

  • Build and own an evaluation/regression harness across all Lab products — accuracy, latency, cost-per-transaction, exception rate
  • Govern prompt/model versions in production; roll back safely, catch provider-side regressions
  • Instrument cost, latency, and drift observability with alerting before issues reach pilots
  • Define CI/CD for AI products — prompt testing, eval-gated deploys

4. Product Development & Prototyping

  • Lead hands-on development of AI agent prototypes, Gate 0 to Gate 1
  • Build and maintain agentic workflows on LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, open-source models)
  • Integrate financial ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), reconciliation platforms, document processing APIs
  • Ship production-quality prototype code, not proof-of-concept demos
  • Instrument per-MVP evaluation metrics: accuracy, latency, cost-per-transaction, exception rate

5. Client Pilot Technical Support

  • Deploy MVPs into client pilot environments — secure data handling, access management, audit logging
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues during active pilots with the Lab Head and delivery team
  • Turn pilot findings into product backlog items
  • Prepare technical due-diligence materials for client security/procurement reviews

6. People Leadership

  • Hire and grow the tech team (AI/ML and full-stack) as the Lab scales, staying hands-on in code review and architecture decisions
  • Own sprint cadence — planning, prioritization, demos — aligned to Gate milestones
  • Run performance management and career development for direct reports, anchored to technical growth; flag skill gaps to the Lab Head
  • Allocate work across AI/ML and full-stack to maximize throughput without compromising quality or security

7. Technology Governance & Risk

  • Maintain a technology risk log: API dependencies, model performance, data handling, vendor concentration
  • Own unit economics per product — API cost, infra cost, per-transaction margin
  • Escalate client data usage, consent, or residency issues before go-live
  • Ensure technology-partner arrangements are reflected in IP and vendor agreements

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Essential

  • 8–10 years of software engineering or ML engineering experience, including 4+ years in a technical leadership/team-lead capacity
  • Production experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications or autonomous AI agents
  • Strong Python; API integration patterns, async architecture, data pipeline design
  • Built data pipelines for multi-modal/unstructured inputs — OCR, embeddings/vector stores for RAG, semi-structured extraction
  • Integrated financial ERP APIs or document-processing pipelines (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or equivalent)
  • Working knowledge of RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation — has built evaluation/observability tooling, not just used it
  • Demonstrable 0-to-1 build experience: concept to client-facing prototype
  • Hired, managed, and developed a technical team spanning AI/ML and software engineering disciplines

Preferred

  • Full-stack development experience (React/TypeScript or equivalent) sufficient to review and unblock front-end/dashboard work
  • Experience in Finance & Accounting process automation (AP/AR, reconciliation, expense management, contract management)
  • Exposure to agentic frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar
  • Experience with data residency, SOC 2, DPDP 2023, or client data handling requirements in an enterprise SaaS or BPO context
  • Prior work in an outsourcing, shared services, or BPO technology environment
  • Experience with MLOps/LLMOps tooling (LangSmith, Weights & Biases, MLflow, or equivalent) for evaluation and observability at scale

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative field
  • Relevant professional certifications (AWS/GCP/Azure AI, Databricks, or equivalent) are advantageous but not required

COMPETENCY PROFILE

Builder Mentality

Comfortable with ambiguity; gets to a working artefact quickly and iterates. Produces code, not slides.


System Thinking

Designs for scale, security, cost, and observability from the start — not retrofitted after the demo.

Commercial Awareness

Understands unit economics. Tracks cost-per-transaction and ties architecture decisions to margin.


Client Orientation

Treats client data with production-grade rigor, including DPDP 2023 obligations. Zero tolerance for data-handling shortcuts.

Team Multiplier

Grows the team’s technical capability by staying hands-on: hires for real gaps, reviews code personally, unblocks rather than delegates. Not a people-manager-first profile.


Risk Clarity

Surfaces technical risks early and in plain language — does not manage upward by omission.

Data Engineering Rigor

Handles unstructured and multi-modal data (documents, images, semi-structured exports) with the same rigor as structured data. Data quality and lineage are first-order, not afterthoughts.


WORKING CONTEXT & STRUCTURE

The Engineering Manager, AI/ML Innovation & Product Engineering operates within a small team. The Lab is structured for speed and accountability — there are no large committees, no handoffs to a separate QA team, and no separation between 'build' and 'deploy.' The expectation is that this individual owns the technical outcome end-to-end.

Direct Reports


Lab tech team (AI/ML + full-stack engineers)

Reporting to


Innovation Lab Head (commercial lead)

Peer Relationships


BPS SMEs / Delivery Leads (domain input); US Hunter (client requirements translation)

Governance Interface


BPS CEO — escalation path for IP, data, and vendor risk issues

Technology Stack


Python, LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI), agentic frameworks, financial ERP APIs, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure)

Key Dependencies


IP arrangement with technology partners must be resolved before development begins; client data consent framework must be in place before pilot deployment

Travel


Primarily India-based. Occasional travel to client sites or US for pilot support as required

title: Manager Software Engineering (Engineering Manager)
jobDescription:
ROLE SUMMARY

We are seeking a highly experienced, strategic, and hands-on Manager with at least 10 years of deep expertise in engineering customer support, escalation management, and customer relations.

In this role, you will be the leader of the Engineering teams for one of the SCADA/HMI products which is a key revenue driver within Velotic. You will lead and scale a high-performing engineering team with focus on customer triage, system trouble shooting, customer support, establish robust defect triage, escalation frameworks, and build strong, high-trust relationships with customers and key stake holders. You will bridge the gap between our customers, support engineers, product managers, and software developers to ensure rapid issue resolution and high product reliability.

1. Team Leadership & Operations Management

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a multi-tiered engineering support team to deliver exceptional service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Establish operational KPIs and metrics (e.g., First Response Time, Mean Time to Resolution, Backlog Health, Escalation Rate) and drive continuous process improvements.
  • Manage shift rotations, resource planning across different geographies and time zones.
  • Build a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and customer-first empathy within the team.

2. Defect Flow, Triage & Engineering Collaboration

  • Own and optimize the end-to-end defect triage lifecycle from customer reporting to delivering engineering fixes.
  • Conduct regular triage syncs with Customer Support leadership to prioritize critical bug fixes, hotfixes, and patch releases.
  • Standardize issue root-cause analysis (RCA) and ensure technical ticket descriptions, logs, and reproduction steps are documented.
  • Track product reliability patterns and advocate for product quality enhancements based on recurring customer issues.

3. Customer Relationship & Escalation Management

  • Serve as the primary executive sponsor and single point of contact for high-priority/VIP customer escalations.
  • Build and maintain strong, empathetic relationships with key stakeholders, enterprise clients, and account managers.
  • Host regular operational reviews (QBRs/EBRs) with key accounts to review support performance, open issues, and system stability.
  • Communicate technical updates clearly and transparently to non-technical client stakeholders during critical incidents or service outages.

4. Process Automation & Tooling

  • Evaluate, optimize, and manage support tooling (ADO, Jira, Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow).
  • Implement AI-driven workflow automations, self-service portals, and knowledge base frameworks to improve deflect rates and agent productivity.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 10+ years in technical product development, software customer support, or client services, with at least 5+ years in a direct managerial/leadership role. Experience in SCADA/HMI and C++ is a plus. Knowledge of industrial communication standards (Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, Kepware), and operational technology (OT) cybersecurity.
  • Technical Acumen: Deep understanding of enterprise software product lifecycles, API integrations, log analysis, dump analysis, and SDLC workflows.
  • Defect & Bug Management: Advanced proficiency in ADO/Jira/Confluence (or equivalent) for defect tracking, sprint planning, and triage workflows.
  • Stakeholder Management: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a proven track record of de-escalating enterprise client situations.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong data-driven approach to tracking performance metrics, identifying systemic product bugs, and presenting executive-level reports.

Process Orientation: Expertise in ITIL frameworks, incident management standards, and root cause analysis methodologies.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelors degree in computer science or in “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math)
  • 10 years of relevant experience

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • [Hybrid]
  • No Travel needed

Position Summary
We are seeking a strategic and transformational Director of Technology Product Management to lead a portfolio of AI-powered provider, clinical, and specialty healthcare products. This leader will define product strategy, drive innovation, and deliver solutions that improve clinical outcomes, provider experience, operational efficiency, and business value.

    • Define and execute the vision, roadmap, and investment strategy for provider, clinical, and specialty products

    • Identify opportunities to improve quality, affordability, provider experience, and operational efficiency through AI-enabled solutions
  • Product Leadership
    • Own end-to-end product lifecycle from strategy through execution and value realization
    • Prioritize investments based on business impact, customer needs, and measurable outcomes
    • Drive modernization and digital transformation across clinical and provider-facing platforms
  • Stakeholder Partnership
    • Partner with clinical, operational, technology, and business leaders to align priorities and deliver value
    • Influence senior executives and serve as a trusted advisor on product and AI strategy
  • Leadership and Team Development
    • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers and Product Leaders
    • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning
    • Build organizational AI fluency and champion responsible AI adoption
  • Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment).   • 5+ years leading product teams and people leaders
  • Experience delivering provider, clinical, specialty care, payer, or healthcare technology solutions
  • Experience with AI, machine learning, or data-driven products
  • Proven success driving enterprise-scale product strategy and execution
  • Proven solid communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management skills

  • Master''s degree (MBA, Healthcare Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field)
  • Experience with Generative AI, AI agents, LLMs, and healthcare AI solutions
  • Experience leading large transformation or modernization programs

  • Strategic Vision Product Thinking
  • AI Digital Transformation Leadership
  • Executive Influence Change Leadership
  • Talent Development Coaching
  • Outcome-Based Decision Making
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
Success Measures:
  • Accelerates AI adoption across provider and clinical products.
  • Delivers measurable improvements in provider experience, clinical outcomes, and operational efficiency.

You will set and enforce the reliability bar for your platforms through modern Site Reliability Engineering practices, drive cloud-native modernization, and lead practical AI adoption across both the products you build and the way your teams engineer them.

    • Operate a global delivery model with US-based counterparts: clear ownership boundaries, follow-the-sun handoffs, and equitable on-call distribution across time zones
  • Site Reliability Engineering
    • Own reliability, availability, performance, and operational readiness for all platforms in the portfolio
    • Establish and govern SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets; use error-budget policy to drive engineering priority decisions

    • Establish and enforce reference architectures, engineering standards, review practices, and non-functional requirements across teams
    • Own the technical debt and modernization backlog; make explicit, documented trade-offs between speed, cost, risk, and maintainability
    • Run architecture review and design authority forums for the domain; align with Enterprise Architecture on cross-domain decisions
    • Produce clear decision records and defend technical directions to executive stakeholders in business terms (cost, risk, time-to-market, member impact)
  • Cloud Platform Engineering
    • Lead cloud-native design and delivery on public cloud (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP considered) containers/AKS, serverless, API management, event-driven architectures
    • Lead migration and modernization of legacy and on-premises workloads to cloud-native targets
    • Own cloud cost management and FinOps discipline for the portfolio, including unit economics and demonstrated optimization
    • Mature CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and progressive delivery (blue/green, canary, feature flags)

    • Lead integration of AI/ML and GenAI capabilities into products and platforms, from use-case selection through production operation and monitoring
    • Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering tooling across the organization and hold teams accountable to measurable productivity and quality outcomes
    • Apply responsible AI practices with Legal, Compliance, and Security - model governance, evaluation, human-in-the-loop design, bias and drift monitoring, data-use controls
    • Distinguish credible AI opportunities from hype and make disciplined investment recommendations to leadership

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.
Functions may include database architecture, engineering, design, optimization, security, and administration; as well as data modeling, big data development, Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) development, storage engineering, data warehousing, data provisioning and other similar roles. Responsibilities may include Platform-as-a-Service and Cloud solution with a focus on data stores and associated eco systems. Duties may include management of design services, providing sizing and configuration assistance, ensuring strict data quality, and performing needs assessments. Analyzes current business practices, processes and procedures as well as identifying future business opportunities for leveraging data storage and retrieval system capabilities. Manages relationships with software and hardware vendors to understand the potential architectural impact of different vendor strategies and data acquisition. May design schemas, write SQL or other data markup scripting and helps to support development of Analytics and Applications that build on top of data. Selects, develops and evaluates personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function. Generally work is self-directed and not prescribed.
Primary Responsibilities:
  • Data Pipeline Development
    • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL Server, SSIS, Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, Airflow, and dbt
    • Support and enhance legacy SSIS pipelines while contributing to modernization efforts
    • Ensure timely, accurate, and secure data movement across systems
    • Implement and maintain robust logging, error handling, and auditing frameworks
    • Participate in peer reviews and support reusable, framework-driven engineering practices
  • Analytics Semantic Layer (Legacy SSAS Support)
    • Provide maintenance and enhancement support for SSAS Tabular and/or Multidimensional models
    • Troubleshoot processing issues, performance bottlenecks, and security role configurations
    • Ensure SSAS models continue to meet reporting and analytics needs during modernization transitions
  • Reporting Data Delivery
    • Support reporting via SSRS, Power BI, and Tableau
    • Validate data accuracy and ensure outputs meet stakeholder needs
    • Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver actionable insights and promote self-service reporting
    • Assist with legacy SSRS report maintenance and performance tuning as needed
  • Performance Tuning Optimization
    • Optimize performance across SQL Server, Snowflake, SSIS, ADF, dbt, Airflow, and reporting platforms
    • Tune T SQL queries, stored procedures, indexing strategies, and data models
    • Identify and remediate bottlenecks across pipelines, semantic layers, and reporting workloads
    • Partner with platform teams to improve reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency
  • Data Modeling (Relational Dimensional)
    • Design and maintain relational and dimensional data models supporting analytics, reporting, and operational workflows
    • Apply best practices for star schema design, SCD handling, and semantic consistency
    • Document data structures, lineage, and business logic for cross-team clarity
  • Documentation Support
    • Document pipeline logic, dependencies, and operational procedures
    • Respond to incidents and service requests through ServiceNow
    • Follow change control, governance, and compliance standards (HIPAA, ITIL)
  • Collaboration Continuous Learning
    • Participate in sprint ceremonies and design reviews
    • Communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences
    • Share knowledge through documentation and peer support
    • Embrace feedback and contribute to a positive, growth-oriented team culture
  • Works with less structured, more complex issues
  • Serves as a resource to others
  • Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so
Required Qualifications:
  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
  • Data platform or cloud certifications
  • 10+ years of experience with Snowflake, Synapse, or cloud native data platforms
  • Experience with SSAS or other legacy BI components
  • Experience with CozyRoc SSIS+ or other third-party ETL/ELT components
  • Experience with data APIs (ServiceNow, UKG, Kronos)
  • Experience with healthcare data constructs or clinical systems
  • Exposure to AI/ML concepts, tools, or platforms (e.g., Azure Machine Learning, Python ML libraries, AI-assisted development tools)
At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

jobDescription:
Project Role :Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description :Design, build and configure applications to meet business process and application requirements.
Must have skills :.Net Full Stack Development
Good to have skills :NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary:
Seeking a forward-thinking professional with an AI-first mindset to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade solutions using Generative and Agentic AI frameworks that drive innovation, efficiency, and business transformation.Roles & Responsibilities:Lead AI-driven solution design and delivery by applying GenAI and Agentic AI to address complex business challenges, automate processes, and integrate intelligent insights into enterprise workflows for measurable impact.Professional & Technical Skills:Strong grasp of Generative and Agentic AI, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation frameworks. Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization.Overview:We are seeking a seasoned Full Stack Enterprise Architect with deep expertise in designing and implementing application-heavy, multi-cloud enterprise solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in applications, infrastructure and integration, with hands-on experience in .NET Core, MVC Framework and Python, as well as exposure to modern front-end technologies like React or Angular. A solid understanding of AI and its integration into enterprise systems is essential. This role will drive the architecture of scalable, secure, and innovative solutions to support business objectives across multiple cloud platforms. Key Responsibilities:Solution Architecture:Design end-to-end, application-heavy enterprise architectures that integrate infrastructure, applications, data and platforms across multi-cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Application Development Leadership:Lead the design and implementation of robust, scalable applications with a focus on full-stack development, ensuring alignment with business goals. Integration Strategy:Architect seamless integrations between systems, applications, and third-party services using APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures. Multi-Cloud Strategy:Develop and implement strategies for deploying and managing applications across multiple cloud platforms, ensuring portability, scalability, and cost optimization. Technology Leadership:Provide technical guidance on .NET, and Python-based backend systems, and modern front-end frameworks like React or Angular. AI Adoption:Incorporate GenAI/Agentic AI capabilities into enterprise applications, leveraging frameworks and tools to enhance productivity & functionality (e.g., predictive analytics, automation). Infrastructure Design:Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design cloud-native solutions, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and IaC (Terraform, Bicep). Performance & Security:Ensure solutions are optimized for performance, scalability, and security, adhering to industry standards and best practices. Stakeholder Collaboration:Work closely with product managers, developers, DevOps, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions. Innovation & Trends:Stay updated on emerging technologies, including AI advancements, cloud trends, and full-stack development practices, to drive continuous improvement.
Qualifications & Skills:Experience:12 to 20+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, with at least 3 to 5 years in a full-stack architect role focusing on application-heavy solutions. Proven track record of designing and deploying solutions in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Hands-on experience with .NET Core, ASP.Net and Python for backend development. Exposure to front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or similar frameworks. Strong understanding of AI concepts and their application in enterprise systems. Expertise in integration patterns (e.g., REST, Azure Integration Services, GraphQL, Kafka, message queues) and microservices architecture. Exposure to big data technologies (e.g., Fabrics, Hadoop, Spark) and data integration pipelines. Experience with infrastructure components such as containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless computing, and IaC tools (Terraform, Bicep). Understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and logging tools. Knowledge of enterprise security practices, including IAM, encryption, and compliance standards. Soft Skills:
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication and leadership abilities to guide cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly language.
  • Proactive, innovative mindset with a focus on delivering scalable solutions. Education:Bachelor??s or master??s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Fundamentals, TOGAF, DevOps Engineer Expert or similar) are a plus.

    Qualification
    15 years full time education

descriptionFromApi:
Project description
hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, optimizing, and productizing high-performance computer vision and AI pipelines for consumer devices. This role ensures real-time performance, power efficiency, and production robustness across embedded platforms.
Responsibilities
Design and implement advanced computer vision and image processing pipelines optimized for real-time consumer devices.
Collaborate with ISP, sensor, and tuning teams to optimize image quality for downstream AI and UX performance.
Develop and deploy ML models for visual recognition, enhancement, tracking, or scene understanding.
Optimize ML models for edge deployment (quantization, pruning, distillation, hardware-aware tuning).
Implement performance-critical algorithms in modern C++ for embedded platforms.
Optimize for latency, power consumption, memory footprint, and thermal constraints.
Integrate inference engines (TFLite, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, etc.) on target SoCs.
Work closely with Android/Linux platform teams to integrate camera and AI pipelines.
Define and track KPIs: FPS, power usage, memory, startup time, and accuracy.
Profile and optimize performance across CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP.
Drive debugging of complex system-level issues in production builds.
Ensure robust unit testing and contribute to automated validation pipelines.
Mentor engineers and review architecture/design proposals.
Support product bring-up and mass production readiness.
Skills
Must have
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
  • 7-10+ years of experience in computer vision/image processing.
  • Proven experience shipping at least one consumer product with embedded vision/AI.
  • Strong C++ expertise (C++14/17/20), including performance optimization.
  • Strong experience with OpenCV and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX).
  • Experience deploying ML models on embedded/edge devices.
  • Experience with model optimization (quantization, pruning).
  • Strong understanding of 2D/3D geometry and linear algebra.
  • Experience working on embedded Linux or Android systems.
  • Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.
  • Experience optimizing for power and thermal constraints.
Nice to have
  • Experience with mobile SoCs (Qualcomm, MediaTek, Exynos, etc.).
  • Experience with CUDA / OpenCL / Vulkan / OpenGL ES / SIMD.
  • Experience with camera calibration and ISP interaction.
  • Experience building for Android Camera HAL or Yocto-based systems.
  • Experience with AR, computational photography, or video processing.
  • Experience with multi-camera systems.
  • Exposure to production validation and manufacturing constraints.

Project Role Description :Design, develop and maintain data solutions for data generation, collection, and processing. Create data pipelines, ensure data quality, and implement ETL (extract, transform and load) processes to migrate and deploy data across systems.
Must have skills :Data Engineering, Snowflake Data Warehouse
Good to have skills :Machine Learning
Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary Lead the architecture, strategy, and delivery of enterprise-scale data platforms on Snowflake. Own technical direction for data modeling, ingestion, performance, security, governance, and developer experience. Mentor engineers and collaborate with stakeholders to deliver robust, scalable, and secure data solutions for analytics, AI/ML, and operational use cases. Roles and responsibilities:Architecture & Strategy
  • Define target data platform architecture (multi-environment, multi-account, integration patterns).
  • Establish technical standards for ELT, dbt/Snowpark, data contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Lead make/buy/standardize decisions for connectors, CDC/integration tools, orchestration, catalog, and observability.
  • Design and Implement CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workflows
  • Design and Implement Streaming data architectures and Micro-service based architectures
  • Design and implement reliable ingestion and transformation pipelines (batch/streaming) using Snowflake features (Snowpipe, Streams & Tasks, external stages) and orchestration tools (Airflow/ADF).
  • Drive data modeling best practices (dimensional, data vault, wide tables) with versioning, testing, and documentation.
  • Enable CI/CD, environment promotion, automated data quality checks (dbt tests, Great Expectations), and blue-green deployments. Performance, Reliability & Cost
  • Lead workload management, query optimization, clustering, and caching strategies.
  • Implement resource monitors, autosuspend policies, and cost observability dashboards.
  • Own SLA/SLOs for key data products, incident runbooks, lineage-aware impact analysis, and post-incident reviews. Security, Compliance & Sharing
  • Define and enforce RBAC/ABAC, row/column-level security, masking policies, and secrets management.
  • Partner with Security/GRC on auditing, data retention, PII/PHI protection, and regulatory compliance (GDPR/CCPA).
  • Operationalize secure data sharing and cleanroom patterns for internal/external collaboration. Leadership & Influence
  • Serve as principal technical authority for Snowflake; mentor engineers and elevate team capability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Analytics, and ML teams to deliver scalable, reusable data products.
  • Author architecture decision records (ADRs), roadmaps, and executive-level technical narratives. Technical experience & Professional attributes:
  • 12+ years in data engineering/architecture; 6+ years designing and operating Snowflake at scale (multi-TB warehouses, 1000s of daily jobs).
  • Expert SQL and deep knowledge of Snowflake internals:virtual warehouses, micropartitions, clustering, Query Profile, caching, Time Travel, Failsafe.
  • Hands-on with Snowflake workloads & features:Snowpipe, Streams & Tasks, stages/external tables, materialized views, Secure Data Sharing.
  • Experience with at least one transformation framework (dbt strongly preferred) and programming language (Python, Snowpark, UDFs).
  • Experience with orchestration (Airflow/ADF/Argo), CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/GitLab/Azure DevOps), and IaC (Terraform).
  • Fluency with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), object storage (S3/ADLS/GCS), networking (VPC/VNet, PrivateLink/Private Endpoints).
  • Solid grounding in data governance (catalog/lineage tools), privacy & security controls, and observability (logs/metrics/traces for pipelines).
  • Experience in Fivetran and streaming tools Kafka, Pulsar or other equivalent.
  • Performance tuning at scale:warehouse sizing, task concurrency, pruning/clustering, cost optimization.
  • Excellent communication; able to present architecture tradeoffs to engineers and executives. Preferred Skills
  • SnowPro Advanced:Architect or Advanced:Data Engineer certification.
  • Data quality frameworks ,data contracts, and contract-testing patterns.
